Deq shapes as typed, tree-shakable React components.

```tsx
import { RojHalfSun, DeqIcon } from "@0xdolan/deq-react";
<RojHalfSun size={32} strokeWidth={1.5} absoluteStrokeWidth />
<DeqIcon name="kurdish-sun" color="#ED2024" />
```

Source: [`packages/react`](../../packages/react/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-react`.

## Per-shape exports

93 generated exports, one per shape, such as `ArchDot`, `ArchDotColumn`, `ArrowDown`. The [icon list](https://kanilabs.github.io/deq/icons/) shows every shape.

## Functions

### `DeqIcon`

```ts
function DeqIcon({ name, ...props }: DeqIconByNameProps): ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

Any icon by catalog id: `<DeqIcon name="roj-half-sun" />`. It keeps every icon in the
bundle; import the named components (`RojHalfSun`) to tree-shake.

**@throws** {DeqError} `UNKNOWN_SHAPE` for an id that is not in the catalog.

### `createDeqIcon`

```ts
function createDeqIcon(icon: DeqIcon, displayName: string): FunctionComponent<DeqIconProps>
```

Make a typed component from icon data (`@0xdolan/deq-icons`). The generated components
use this; call it yourself for custom icon data.


## Interfaces

### `DeqIconByNameProps`

```ts
interface DeqIconByNameProps
```

Props of `DeqIcon`: an icon picked by catalog id.

- `name: string`: Catalog id, for example `roj-half-sun`.
- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.

### `DeqIconProps`

```ts
interface DeqIconProps
```

Props of every Deq icon component; other SVG props pass through to the `<svg>`.

- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.
